audience: Prompt authors who need a quick, private written-control review
audienceContext: A prompt author has an existing agent instruction set and wants to find exactly what is absent without uploading it.
persona: Mira, support lead for fictional Northstar Clinic
problem: An otherwise thorough prompt can omit an explicit human review instruction for consequential actions.
outcome: The author identifies a specific missing written control, reviews its wording, and rescans the local text.
viewerUnits: One prompt, three concrete omissions, and one selected written control
guardrail: The author selects and edits a suggested control before it changes the in-browser prompt; the result explicitly states that text coverage is not runtime proof.
emotionalTarget: Calm confidence from a precise, inspectable local review rather than a generic safety grade.

beforeState.costShown: A detailed fictional prompt is visible, but the missing approval wording is not obvious by inspection.

heroMoment.reveal: The real checker updates from 20 to 21 written controls immediately after the selected wording is applied.
heroMoment.staging: Short silence before the rescan result, then a readable hold on the updated count and the runtime-proof limitation.

segments.action: Show the filled fictional prompt in the actual checker without submitting it yet.
segments.expectedState: The prompt textarea contains the deterministic fictional clinic support instructions; the primary action is visible.
segments.primaryIdea: Useful-looking instructions can still hide an omitted written control.
segments.wiifm: See the real starting point before trusting a result.
segments.narration: A useful AI prompt can still miss the written control that keeps a sensitive action in review.
segments.eyeDirectionTreatment: Read the visible prompt, then land on Find missing guardrails.
protectedRegions: Prompt textarea and primary checker action
segments.pacePatternChange: Cold open on real prompt content.

segments.action: Submit the visible prompt through the real browser-local checker.
segments.expectedState: The actual result panel renders for the same prompt without an upload or remote model call.
segments.primaryIdea: The check is local and inspectable.
segments.wiifm: Review written controls without sending this prompt elsewhere.
segments.narration: This fictional support prompt stays in the browser while CrewScore checks the public written controls.
segments.eyeDirectionTreatment: Move from the primary action to the result heading.
segments.pacePatternChange: Action transitions to the result panel.

segments.action: Hold the controls-first result and its three concrete suggestions.
segments.expectedState: The result visibly reports 20 of 23 written guardrails found and three controls may be missing.
segments.primaryIdea: The checker names omissions instead of assigning a safety tier.
segments.wiifm: Turn a vague prompt review into three checkable decisions.
segments.narration: It found twenty of twenty-three written guardrails. Three controls may be missing.
segments.eyeDirectionTreatment: Read count, then scan the three suggestions.

segments.action: Open review, select A human must approve, and display the editable wording and unified diff.
segments.expectedState: The selected control is explicit, editable, costed, and previewed before application.
segments.primaryIdea: Suggested wording is a reviewable choice, not blindly applied boilerplate.
segments.wiifm: Keep control over exactly what changes in the prompt.
segments.narration: Review the exact wording before adding it. Select only the control this prompt actually needs.
segments.eyeDirectionTreatment: Move from checkbox to wording and then the diff.
protectedRegions: Selected control, editable wording, and diff

segments.action: Apply the selected wording and hold the actual rescored result.
segments.expectedState: The textarea changes locally and the result updates to 21 of 23 written guardrails found.
segments.primaryIdea: One specific reviewed control produces a visible local rescan.
segments.wiifm: Know precisely what was added and see its text-level effect immediately.
segments.narration: The selected wording is added only in this browser, then rescored. Now twenty-one controls are written down.
segments.eyeDirectionTreatment: Pause before the new result count, then stay on it.
protectedRegions: Updated result count and runtime-proof disclosure
segments.pacePatternChange: Hero rescan with a readable count hold.

segments.action: Show the native result-sharing controls and the on-screen prompt-free sharing explanation.
segments.expectedState: The real result panel says a result link includes only ruleset and control IDs, never prompt text.
segments.primaryIdea: The shareable summary preserves the prompt boundary.
segments.wiifm: Bring a review result to a team without copying the instruction text into the link.
segments.narration: Share the control summary if you need to, not the prompt. CrewScore finds missing written guardrails; it does not prove runtime safety.
segments.eyeDirectionTreatment: Read the prompt-free share explanation, then close on the coverage limitation.
segments.pacePatternChange: End-card hold on the product's truthful limitation.
